theme: Dual Theme (Light/Dark). Default to high-contrast Dark Mode for the Marketing Landing Page to maximize visual impact, and provide a clean Light/Dark toggle for the Student Portal.

headings.usage: Hero typography, Section Titles, Stat Numbers. Must feel bold and structural.

body.usage: Paragraphs, Dashboard Data, UI Elements, Tooltips.

mono.usage: Mock test timers, code snippets in doubt solver, small technical labels (uppercase + wide tracking).

marketing_bento.cards: rounded-3xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl p-8 overflow-hidden relative transition-transform duration-500 hover:scale-[1.02]

dashboard.cards: rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6 shadow-sm

layouts.spacing: Use generous padding. Sections should use py-24 or py-32. Internal card padding p-8. Avoid cramped UI.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use heavily for fixed headers and floating UIs. Require `backdrop-blur-xl` and a 1px solid inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No cheap linear gradients. Use subtle, large radial gradients for background glows (e.g., a massive 800px radial glow of primary blue at 10% opacity fixed behind the bento grid).
visual_enhancers.noise: Add a subtle SVG noise filter overlay (opacity 2-4%) across the marketing page to break the digital flatness.

motion.lenis: Mandatory for smooth momentum scrolling on the marketing site. Initializes in the main layout.
motion.kinetic_hero: Masked line-by-line reveal. Split the H1 into lines, wrap each in an `overflow-hidden` span, and animate the inner text from `y: '100%'` to `y: '0%'` using Framer Motion with an elastic spring.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use Framer Motion `whileInView`. Elements should fade and slide up subtly (y: 40 -> 0) with staggered delays.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons should have a subtle scale down on tap (`whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}`). Links should have sliding underlines.

marketing: Hero Section: Kinetic text, subtle CSS 3D floating 'Knowledge Cube' using framer-motion (rotateX/Y mapped to mouse position), and primary CTA.
Editorial Marquee: High-contrast, very slow scrolling outline text (text-transparent stroke-white) saying 'JEE ADVANCED • NEET UG • CBSE BOARDS • CUET'. Use `react-fast-marquee`.
Stats Band: Massive typography stats (e.g., '1M+ Students', '99.9% Success') counting up when in view.
Bento Grid: Must include custom interactive mini-UIs inside the cards (e.g., Mock Tests card shows a mini bar chart, AI Doubt Solver card shows a looping typing chat animation).
Courses Section: Premium grid of upcoming live classes with imagery and subtle hover zoom on images.
Testimonials: Masonry layout or a smooth, infinite horizontal scroll of student reviews.
Footer: Massive 'Vidhyasetu' logo text at the bottom, standard links, social icons.
dashboard: Navigation: Persistent sidebar containing Logo, primary routes (Dashboard, Mock Tests, Library, Doubt AI), and user profile at the bottom.
Overview: Progress AreaChart (Recharts), Streak tracker (Flame icon + day count), Upcoming Schedule list.

Mock Test Engine: Immersive, full-screen mode UI. Sticky top bar with countdown timer, question palette grid on the right, question text and options on the left, 'Submit Test' functionality leading to a scored results view.
AI Doubt Solver: Dedicated chat interface route resembling modern LLM UIs (Shadcn ScrollArea, Input, Button) with simulated AI responses.
components_and_features.logo: Create an original SVG component (a geometric 'V' intersecting a cube) in Electric Blue. Use this throughout the site and export it as the favicon.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Vidhyasetu', an Awwwards-level EdTech platform. Your work must be exceptional, not generic.
Implement React Router to handle the dual nature: Marketing Landing Page (/) and Student SaaS Portal (/dashboard, /test, /library, /ai-chat).
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, lucide-react, recharts, react-fast-marquee, clsx, tailwind-merge, sonner.
For the hero, use a large kinetic text reveal. Wrap text lines in spans with `overflow: hidden`, and animate the inner span upwards using framer-motion.
Create an interactive 3D-feeling 'Knowledge Cube' in the hero using CSS transforms (rotateX/rotateY mapped to mouse coordinates via framer-motion `useScroll` or `useTransform`).
In the Marketing Bento grid, create actual mini-UIs inside the cards (e.g., a tiny Recharts graph in the Analytics card, a mini typing animation in the AI card). Do not just use static images.
Build a fully functional UI for the Mock Test Engine, including a sticky timer, question palette grid, and a post-submission results view.
Ensure all interactive elements have descriptive `data-testid` attributes.
DO NOT use placeholder image services. ONLY use the Unsplash URLs provided in this file.

Use standard DOM elements (`div`, `section`) with Tailwind for the highly custom marketing layouts, but leverage Shadcn components for the complex interactive SaaS elements (Dropdowns, Dialogs, Inputs).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Build something that looks hand-crafted and expensive.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry to create visual tension.
DO NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform` to prevent breaking framer-motion.
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS. Respect natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations. Avoid generic rounded-md blue buttons.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, scaling, underlines).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Empty space is premium.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from `src/components/ui` when applicable, and use `sonner` for all toasts.
